mentions.name: Celerp
mentions.description: A local-first replacement for accounting and business management software, built as a modular system that lets users develop their own modules and import them into a running instance without forking the repository.
mentions.source_excerpt: For the last 6 months I've been working on a local-first replacement for accounting and business management software. I just finished building a modular system that I'm pretty proud of, which lets users develop their own modules and import them into a running instance without having to fork the repo.
